name: Density-preserving Gaussian splitting
definition: A splitting operation that modifies the resulting density of split Gaussians to be similar to the density of the parent Gaussian, preventing perturbations in the loss function and avoiding Gaussian clusters.
summary: Density-preserving Gaussian splitting is a 3D Gaussian Splatting densification strategy that prevents loss perturbations and clustering by discarding cloning and adapting child parameters to match parent density.
